decision.reason: The only evidence is one release-note line, filed under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)" [ev-8ec1fdd0d15f]. It says the internal `third_party/forked/acme` package was patched to support the ACME profiles extension. It names no CRD field, Issuer setting, Helm value, flag or CA behaviour that would make an environment use the extension. That means no applicability condition can be written from it. The line just points to PR #7776, so we need the PR or the related docs to show whether and how operators can reach this through configuration.
